# fireworks_deployed_model (Resource)

A LoRA model loaded onto a dedicated deployment or onto serverless (the API calls this a deployed model). Set exactly one of `deployment` or `serverless = true`.

~> A dedicated deployment must have addons enabled to accept a LoRA. Destroying this resource unloads the LoRA; the model itself stays in the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Serve the output of a fine-tuning job on serverless.
resource "fireworks_deployed_model" "tuned" {
  model        = fireworks_supervised_fine_tuning_job.tune.output_model
  serverless   = true
  display_name = "llama tune v1"
}

# Or load it onto a dedicated deployment that has addons enabled.
resource "fireworks_deployed_model" "dedicated" {
  model      = "accounts/my-account/models/my-lora"
  deployment = "accounts/my-account/deployments/my-addons-deployment"
  default    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model` (String) LoRA model to load, e.g. accounts/my-account/models/my-lora. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) Whether this copy answers requests to the bare model name, without a #<deployment> suffix. The API sets this to true for the first copy of a model.
- `deployment` (String) Deployment to load onto, e.g. accounts/my-account/deployments/abc123. Conflicts with serverless. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `description` (String) Description (max 1000 characters).
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name (max 64 characters).
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the deployed model is publicly reachable.
- `replace_merged_addon` (Boolean) Merge this LoRA into the base model, unloading any addon already merged there. Required for hot-reload deployments. Only used at create time. Defaults to false.
- `serverless` (Boolean) Load onto the shared serverless pool instead of a deployment. Conflicts with deployment. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Whether to wait until the deployed model reaches DEPLOYED state. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Deployed model ID (last segment of the resource name).
- `name` (String) Full resource name, e.g. accounts/my-account/deployedModels/abc123.
- `state` (String) Current state (DEPLOYING, DEPLOYED, UPDATING, UNDEPLOYING).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import fireworks_deployed_model.tuned <deployed-model-id>
```
